features: Reel Import — Share an Instagram Reel to Echo Music: it identifies the song and asks you to confirm the match, then adds it to a playlist you choose — with an optional default playlist so future reels are added in one tap.
bug_fixes: Reel Import now actually works end to end: the yt-dlp audio-extraction command was invalid (yt-dlp rejected it instantly), so fingerprinting never ran — fixed and verified against a real reel.
The bundled yt-dlp binary is updated to the latest release on first launch, so Instagram's changing site layout no longer breaks metadata or audio extraction.
Audio excerpts are delivered to the fingerprinter as clean 16-bit PCM (WAV container header stripped), preventing possible recognition failures.
